description: Any time a child is injured on or by a Georgia school bus, parents have a right and responsibility to find out what went wrong.
shortAnswer: Parents entrust their children's lives and safety to countless school bus drivers, most of whom deserve that trust. Nevertheless, any time a child is injured on or by a school bus, parents have a right and responsibility to find out what went wrong. Sometimes driver inattention and negligence leads to tragic accidents and child injuries.

faq.q: How many children die in school bus related crashes each year?
faq.a: According to the NHTSA, an average of 19 school-aged children die in school bus related traffic crashes every year. On average 6 of the children die as occupants of a bus and 13 die as pedestrians (getting in or off the bus). Nearly half of those killed are between the ages of 5-7 years of age.

faq.q: Can a Georgia school board be liable for hiring a dangerous bus driver?
faq.a: The local school board has a responsibility to do background checks on applicants, and an ongoing duty to send drivers for periodic medical exams and to do performance evaluations. If a school district fails to discharge any of these duties, and a dangerous driver is permitted to transport school children, civil liability can result for negligent hiring/retention.

faq.q: What are Georgia school bus drivers prohibited from doing to discipline students?
faq.a: Corporal punishment (spanking or other intervention designed to cause pain to the student) is prohibited by Georgia law. So is pepper spray/mace. Also, bus drivers are warned not to discipline students while the bus is in motion.

faq.q: What must bus drivers do to safely secure a child in a wheelchair?
faq.a: The manual describes the duties involved in safely getting a disabled child secured in their wheel chair including preparing the lift, properly positioning the wheelchair once it is lifted onto the bus, attaching the front and rear securement straps, and attaching the lap/shoulder belts. Failure to follow any of these rules could lead to injuries.
